## Version-specific notes

- **Magento 2.4.8 yêu cầu OpenSearch/Elasticsearch ở production** — local env chưa cấu hình engine.
  Verify production engine khi làm infra/deploy task. — version: 2.4.8 → affects: production search
- **Tailwind v4 = CSS-first** — KHÔNG có `tailwind.config.js`. Config qua `@theme`/`@source` trong
  `tailwind-source.css`. Tutorial v3 (JS config) KHÔNG áp dụng. — version: 4.x → affects: theme build
- **Hyvä 3.x + default theme 1.5.2** — verify compat khi override template. — affects: theme
- **Mageplaza modules committed as source** (không qua composer) — version drift risk; verify version
  trong `module.xml` khi update. — affects: module update path

## Rules

- Official docs BEFORE community (★★★★★ vs ★★☆☆☆).
- Mark mọi thứ `[EXTERNAL: verify]` — fast-changing; không tin memory.
- Version mismatch (project version ≠ doc version) → flag; tìm correct-version doc.
- Community/blog → ★★☆☆☆; không bao giờ override project convention hay official docs.
